summary.text: Blood Demon Body Separation is Song Zi Xing's immortal killer move.

claims.text: Fang Yuan looks at a severed arm in a golden bell phantom and names immortal killer move blood demon body separation. During the Central Continent Refinement Path Convention ambush, the ten great sects fail to kill Song Zi Xing. This is the first time the move is displayed, and it shocks the whole of Central Continent. The escape is attributed to it.

The move creates a clone in a short time. The clone’s speed can rival blood rainbow flash. It is realistic and deceptive. Even investigative immortal killer moves cannot see a flaw in it. The price is a body part plus a huge amount of immortal essence to keep the clone in existence. More immortal essence means a longer life for the clone. The deeper cost is blood path dao marks on that flesh. Those marks are why the clone can pass as the real person. If Song Zi Xing later regrows the limb, the new arm is blank of those marks. A record Fang Yuan has says Song Zi Xing escaped this battle with only a head and half a chest left, the rest discarded to use the move. The arm Fang Yuan holds had less than ten beads of immortal essence put into it, because Song Zi Xing was already extremely weak.

Yu Mu Chun sees a blood fetus curled like a sleeping baby and asks whether Song Zi Xing has developed blood demon body separation to this extent. Song Zi Xing says he formed it from Blood Deity remnant recipes, a Northern Plains blood path technique, and this immortal killer move. The fake body from blood demon body separation expends immortal essence and has a time limit. The body this blood fetus makes does not consume immortal essence, and it can be sustained for at least two to three hundred years.
